title: Collab Premiere tomorrow at 11AM
content: Should I burn this painting? Find out what happens tomorrow, Thursday, at 11AM New York time, when Ipremiere a new video about a big YouTubeart collaboration experiment.I join in with YouTubers Ten Hundred, Kiptoe, Jess Karp, and Greg (Craola) Simpkins.The video also includes a visit to the toy collection of Mel Birnkrant, AND my first experiments with the AI art program Dall•E 2.
